effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

levels.text:
Attacks the 10 enemies with the lowest HP% in a 10x20m area in front of Aldous, from a distance of 9m, dealing 278 damage, ignores 5% of the target's DEF. Casts a [10% Weaken] debuff on the targets, lasting 13s, increasing all damage taken by 10%. Then, casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 6s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK).

bio: Disintegrating objects at a molecular level? That's another day in the office for Aldous. As the Academy's head of "energetic research", he's recently had to move his experiments to a specialist test site. A test site on the far, far edge of Sanctum Vale – where he can atomize in peace. He's still hasn't been forgiven for turning the Academy's brand new arcane laboratory into a smoking crater.
